About the Moon Calendar

Heather fell in love with Katherine's original moon calendar, which tracked the waxing and waning of the moon. This calendar began when Heather sent photos of desert moons to Katherine in the city. Katherine printed these monotypes on her printing press.

In Shared Lunacy

Katherine Dale

A New York City-based artist, Katherine has spent the last several years creating Moon Calendars inspired by the diverse locations where she has lived and worked, including Bermuda, New York, Hong Kong, and Joshua Tree. Following a two-decade global career as a Naturopathic Doctor she has returned to her lifelong passion for the printing press.

Instagram

Heather Vescent

Heather Vescent photographs desert moons from her geodesic dome in the Mojave Desert. She is the founder of Golden Goddess Readings, an Akashic Records practice and is a futurist, screenwriter, and author.
